settlement_day_rule: ordinary weekday minus frozen DTC non-settlement dates; Saturday and Sunday are never settlement days; a date marked exchange_closed is still a settlement day unless it is listed in dtc_non_settlement_dates; T+N counts settlement days after the trade date and is not an XNYS row index

known_settlement_only_dates.reason: Carter National Day of Mourning; equity exchanges closed while DTC settlement remained open

notes: 2023-11-10 is Veterans Day and is intentionally absent from dtc_non_settlement_dates because DTC processed settlements that day.
Dates after 2026-08-27 are frozen with the 2026 anticipated holiday list and are outside this study's required coverage.
